snippet.title: Cozy Cookmaster | First Trailer
snippet.description: Cozy Cookmaster is an incremental restaurant management game where you turn a tiny food counter into a busy restaurant. Cook by hand, serve customers, clean tables, unlock new recipes, hire staff, upgrade your kitchen, expand your dining area, and keep your restaurant growing day after day.
